about.heading: Hi, I’m Elena
about.lead: I’m 22 and trying to do cool art. Is it working? You tell me.
about.body:
Most of what I paint are characters — adventurers, villains and oddballs from tabletop campaigns and stories, each one dropped into a world of their own: daisy fields, haunted forests, moonlit villages and colosseums.

I love the details that make a character feel real: an embroidered pair of trousers, a potion on a hip, a murder board covered in red string. Every piece starts with a sketch and a lot of questions about who this person is.
about.teaserText: I’m Elena — 22, and I paint the characters that live in campaigns, notebooks and my head. Knights in daisy fields, a Troll with a murder board, the occasional avocado with a sword.
about.contactText: New pieces, works in progress and the occasional supply haul go up on Instagram first. Want to talk about a piece or a character? Send me a message there.

posts.title: Welcome to the blog
posts.body:
This is a test post, so you can see how the blog looks. Edit or delete it from the admin under Blog.

Posts are written as plain text: leave a blank line between paragraphs and each one becomes its own paragraph on the page. You can pick any artwork on the site as the cover image, or upload a new one.

Some ideas for real posts: works in progress, the story behind a character, a supply haul, or what you're drawing next.
